svg.title: Comparison sensitivities · historical
svg.desc: Eleven descriptive access contrasts, historical era: primary reference, nine comparison, adjustment or precision variations, and one fixed-effects diagnostic with a different estimand. Each row shows a point, interval and zero; values, years and flags are in the linked table.
